subject: science
title: Light and Sound Lab · Q4 W08 D03
objective: Describe how light and sound behave and identify safe ways to protect people.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Light helps us see. Sound comes from vibrations and can travel to our ears. Very bright light and very loud sound can harm us, so use safe levels. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: what you hear when something vibrates
to move back and forth quickly

items.prompt: What forms when light is blocked?

options.text: a loud echo
a warm spot
a shadow
a bright flash

items.explanation: The best answer is: a shadow

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?

options.text: put your ear right next to a loud speaker
scream close to your friend's ear
give your ears a rest from loud noise
play very loud music all day

items.explanation: The best answer is: give your ears a rest from loud noise

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?

options.text: look directly at the Sun
shine a laser at your eyes
never shine a flashlight into someone's eyes
stare at a bright light

items.explanation: The best answer is: never shine a flashlight into someone's eyes

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?

options.text: a vibrating guitar string makes sound
clapping hands makes sound
a whistle makes a high sound
a drum makes sound when struck

items.explanation: The best answer is: a whistle makes a high sound

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?

options.text: a flashlight helps us see
a lamp lights a dark room
a shadow forms when light is blocked
sunlight helps plants grow

items.explanation: The best answer is: a shadow forms when light is blocked
